name: PT FKS Multi Agro Tbk
summary: PT FKS Multi Agro Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, supplies food and feed ingredients in Indonesia. It operates through Trading and Distribution, Manufacturing, and Logistic segments. The company provides food ingredients, such as soybean; sugar, wheat flour, rice flour, corn flour, tapioca flour, chips, wafer sticks, and candies; and dry noodles, vermicelli, and rice. It also offers feed Ingredients, including soyabean and rapeseed meal, corn gluten feed, wheat bran, fishmeal and fish oil, meat bone meal, poultry meat meal, and mono and DI calcium phosphate.
